verdict.rationale: The evidence shows Loops has an API reference (intro page, endpoint listings) and publishes an OpenAPI spec 'for toolchains, validation, and client generation'. Nothing shows the reference is interactive or offers runnable 'try it' examples. A static reference and a machine-readable spec are adjacent building blocks, not the interactive, runnable reference the story asks for.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can explore an interactive API reference with runnable examples
